issue.title: Give the conflict-repair turn the same recovery evidence brief
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Give the conflict-repair turn (`src/sase/finalizers/commit_repair.py`) the same
host-authored evidence brief that declaration recovery now receives: original prompt
head, response tail, dirty-path provenance from the run-start baseline, and the
`tool_calls.jsonl` write list. The repair turn currently invokes the provider the same
context-free way (fresh session, empty window). Conflict markers in the files make it
more self-orienting than declaration recovery was, but it still has no original prompt,
no response, and no provenance.

This is the same structural blind spot as plan:202608/finalizer_recovery_evidence.md,
in a different recovery path. Reuse `build_recovery_evidence` rather than inventing a
second brief.

task_type_fields.proposal: Reuse build_recovery_evidence in src/sase/finalizers/commit_repair.py so the conflict-repair provider invoke is not context-free.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202608/finalizer_recovery_evidence.md only covers declaration recovery; conflict repair is a separate one-shot recovery path.

payload.description: Same context-free provider invoke as the declaration-recovery path this tale fixed
